authorization: User instructed implementation of the four-step review; original RQs, primary data, outcome and models retained.
tie_policy: uniform selection within the cutoff tie, evaluated analytically; no outcome-dependent tie ordering
unique_version_training: unchanged instance-trained models; evaluation-only deduplication; not a deduplicated-training experiment
group_ablation: remove the declared five-feature family, retain release_frequency, package_age, total_versions, is_post_1_0; fit LR/RF/XGB with existing parameters
parameter_selection: no tuning or threshold selection; identical imputation, scaling and estimator parameters to completion protocol

training_sensitivities.lag_eligibility: earlier origin and window_end plus lag <= end-of-day test origin; preserve 12-month labels; nonestimable tests reported
training_sensitivities.late_review_exclusion: omit positive training rows with no matching advisory reviewed by fit cutoff; never relabel as zero; proxy exclusion sensitivity using current ranges, not historical reconstruction
training_sensitivities.identical_training_sets: reuse fits only for byte-identical ordered feature/label training rows at the same test origin; record alias, not an independent replication

uncertainty.scope: paired conditional test-score intervals at focal budget; exploratory percentile; pigeonhole is an additional sensitivity, not proof of full crossed/advisory correction; no training variability
comparisons: full minus no-Libyear within each algorithm
full minus Libyear-only within each algorithm
full LR minus each new simple LR comparator
full minus drop-family within each algorithm

calibration: descriptive reliability bins [0,.01,.02,.05,.1,.2,.5,1], with counts; Brier skill vs constant training positive rate; no recalibration or probability deployment claim
dataset_audit: all-match review timing, all 32 lockfile-label-disagreement instance traces, exact shared-feature/label unit checks, retained/excluded stratum counts; use frozen caches only
scope_exclusions: No first-disclosure target, new cohort, prospective deployment, graph forecasting, new algorithm or causal update effect. No public upload.
